Focused text double-clicks now toggle between Select All and a caret at the clicked position, using selection captured before the first click. Preserve first query focus/Cmd-F select-all, single-click caret, Shift/drag selection and raw Unicode/IME ranges. The shared policy also handles edited numeric text without reformatting its draft or emitting value events; knob reset and nonediting adjustment retain separate gestures. Text/keyboard/IME changes cancel stale pointer anchors.

Original rendered regressions fail on repeated query double-click and numeric draft replacement. Final focused checks:62 widgets,90 browser and20 name-related tests passed (filters overlap); strict UI/widgets all-target Clippy and architecture/GPUI/style/fmt/diff guards passed. Tests use actual down/up click counts, rapid1/2→3/4 pairs, partial/drag/release, bounded startup roots with real workers/ticks/resize, empty text and Unicode/IME replacement while held. Original/intermediate failures and exact evidence are recorded in Pulse2817.
